headline: Shift Data Center Grid Costs
short_summary: This bill aims to make large energy users, such as data centers, responsible for their own grid infrastructure costs, potentially reducing the burden on residential ratepayers.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP1123) on 2026-05-14
opponents: Data center industry, large industrial users
news_headline: Legislation Shifts Virginia Data Center Energy Costs
news_summary: Virginia's HB 1393 directs the primary electric provider to petition the State Corporation Commission to establish rates for recovering costs of increasing electric generating capacity. This bill requires facilities using 25 MW or more to pay for increased generating capacity, preventing these costs from being passed on to other customers.

headline: Report Data Center Water Use
short_summary: This legislation mandates that data centers report their water consumption, providing transparency regarding their environmental footprint and aiding water resource planning.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP0896) on 2026-04-13
supporters: Environmental groups, local communities, water conservation advocates, Senator Kannan Srinivasan
news_headline: Virginia Lawmakers Approve Data Center Water Reporting
news_summary: Virginia's General Assembly passed SB 553 to strengthen water-use reporting requirements for data centers. This legislation aims to provide better data on water supplied to data centers, addressing concerns about the industry's impact on Virginia's water resources.

headline: Regulate Data Center Siting, Noise
short_summary: This bill establishes regulations for the siting of data centers and imposes limits on noise pollution, requiring site assessments to address community concerns.
status: Last Action: Incorporated by Counties, Cities and Towns (HB153-Thomas) (Voice Vote) on 2026-01-23
supporters: Local communities, residents near proposed data center sites, environmental groups, Delegate Joshua Thomas
opponents: Data center developers, real estate industry
news_headline: Virginia Bill Requires Data Center Site Assessments
news_summary: HB 153 mandates that localities require site assessments for new high energy use facilities, including data centers, to examine sound profiles on nearby residential units and schools. It also allows localities to require assessments of impacts on water, agriculture, parks, historic sites, and forestland.
